note: G. R. S. Mead — the titles on gnosis.org/library/grs-mead that the library did not yet hold (checked against `books` by author/title 2026-09-20). Every identifier verified on archive.org the same day: page images served, not access-restricted, imprint 1901–1908 (Theosophical Publishing Society, London; Mead d. 1933 → PD everywhere). Already held and therefore NOT here: Thrice-Greatest Hermes I–III, Pistis Sophia (1896, 1921), Fragments of a Faith Forgotten, Simon Magus, Gnostic John the Baptizer, Echoes I/II/IV/VI/VII/VIII/X. Echoes vol. III (The Vision of Aridaeus) survives on IA only inside a bundle and is imported separately via ia-bundle-import.mjs (manifests/mead-echoes-bundle-2026-09-20.json). The three gospel essays on the site are chapters of The Gospels and the Gospel (1902).
